title: AI Visual & Video Creator
description:
**Designation : AI Visual and Video Creator**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a creative and technically skilled AI Visual and Video Creator to produce high\-quality images, social media creatives, AI reels and promotional videos for multiple brands.

The ideal candidate should understand visual storytelling, social media trends, branding and AI\-powered content creation. This role requires someone who can transform briefs, scripts and product information into engaging visual content.

AI Visual and Video Creator

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Create AI\-generated images, product visuals and branded social media creatives.
* Produce short\-form videos and reels for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and other digital platforms.
* Create AI avatar, voice\-over, explainer, promotional and product demonstration videos.
* Convert scripts and marketing concepts into visually engaging content.
* Edit raw footage and AI\-generated assets into polished videos.
* Add subtitles, transitions, animations, music, sound effects and brand elements.
* Design platform\-specific content in the required dimensions and formats.
* Maintain consistent brand identity across all visuals and videos.
* Create multiple variations of creatives for advertising campaigns and A/B testing.
* Collaborate with content writers, social media executives and performance marketing specialists.
* Research visual trends, viral formats and new AI creative tools.
* Organise project files and deliver content according to the publishing calendar.
* Revise creatives based on internal or client feedback.
* Ensure that AI\-generated content is accurate, appropriate and commercially usable.

**Required Skills :**

* Strong understanding of visual storytelling, composition, typography and colour.
* Proficiency in Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or similar design tools using AI
* Video\-editing experience using CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar software using AI.
* Hands\-on experience with AI image and video\-generation tools.
* Ability to write effective prompts for generating consistent visuals.
* Understanding of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and paid\-ad creatives.
* Ability to maintain character, product and brand consistency in AI\-generated content.
* Good communication, time\-management and attention\-to\-detail skills.
* Ability to manage creative requirements for multiple brands simultaneously.

**Portfolio Requirement:** Candidates must submit 5 AI\-created videos and 5 social media posts developed using AI tools or their graphic\-design skills. Please clearly mention the tools used and their role in creating each sample.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Video Editor
description:
Kody Technolab Ltd. is a publicly listed deep\-tech company specializing in AI\-powered

robotics, autonomous systems, and enterprise software. With 250\+ projects delivered

across 30\+ countries, and a portfolio of proprietary robots (Odigo, Dasher, Spilot, Vulcan,

etc.), we are redefining how businesses adopt automation.

We are now looking for a creative, tech\-savvy Video Editor who can bring our robotics

vision to life through high\-impact videos, product stories, brand campaigns, and investor

grade communication assets.

**Role Overview**

You will be responsible for creating world\-class video content that showcases our robots,

software platforms, customer deployments, brand campaigns, and corporate

communication. This includes product videos, launch films, explainer videos, reels,

motion graphics, and video assets for presentations, events, and PR.

You must understand aesthetics, storytelling, pacing, and be able to interpret technical

content to craft engaging visual narratives.

**What You’ll Do**

* Edit raw footage into polished videos for marketing, product demos, events, and

social media

* Create short\-form videos (reels, shorts, teasers, reveal videos) for brand

amplification

* Produce long\-form content such as walkthroughs, interviews, explainer videos, and

case studies• Craft cinematic, engaging product videos that highlight robotics features \&

interactions

* Create animated visuals, UI overlays, transitions, product callouts, and brand

identity elements

* Design intro/outro sequences aligned with Kody’s brand identity
* Add AI\-focused, futuristic elements \& visual cues where required
* Work closely with marketing, robotics, product \& design teams
* Provide creative direction during shoots; ability to plan and storyboard is a strong

plus

* Collaborate with internal designers and external agencies when needed
* Understand brand tonality, engineering accuracy, and storytelling intent
* Color grading, sound design, music selection \& audio cleanup
* Manage and organize footage, proxies, archives, and project files
* Ensure all exports meet platform specs (LinkedIn, YouTube, social media,

presentations, events)

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* 3\-4 years of experience in video editing, motion graphics, or visual storytelling
* Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro etc.
* Experience using AI video editing and image creation tools
* Ability to edit fast paced and slow cinematic styles
* Great sense of pacing, transitions, music sync, and visual flow
* You’re curious about AI, robotics, automation, and futuristic tech storytelling
* Excellent attention to detail, color sense, typography, and aesthetics
* Ability to work under timelines while maintaining quality
* Experience in filming (camera operation, lighting) is a strong advantage
* Portfolio demonstrating product videos, brand films, and motion graphics

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Lead Solutions Expert - Technology
description:
### **Responsibilities**



Technology Leadership (OT \& Digital)


* Own OT and digital architecture across PLC, SCADA, DCS, IoT, Edge, Historians, AR/ VR, Computer Vision, MES, Digital Twin, Industrial AI, data and analytics platforms.
* Define and enforce technology standards, reference architectures, and lifecycle management practices.
* Act as the technology solutions expert for digital and automation initiatives.


Digital Transformation \& Use Case Enablement


* Translate business and operational requirements into robust digital solutions.
* Enable Industry 4\.0 use cases (MES, Digital Twin, AR/ VR, Computer Vision, Industrial AI) such as predictive maintenance, process optimization, quality and energy optimization.
* Support pilots, POCs and roll\-out in coordination with project and site teams.


OT Systems \& Cybersecurity


* Ensure availability, reliability and performance of OT systems.
* Define and implement OT cybersecurity controls aligned with ISA/IEC 62443\.
* Work very closely with the Cyber security Team and assist in patching and upgrades, backups and disaster recovery exercises for OT environments.


Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE)


* HSE leadership and visible commitment
* Safety‑by‑design for OT \& digital systems
* Statutory and site compliance (PTW, commissioning, maintenance) – for project implementation, the candidate must provide clear guidance pertaining to safety requirements, to the Business Partner and their Team members.
* Contribute to Incident investigation and corrective actions as and when required.
* Use of digital technologies for safety and environmental monitoring


Project \& Delivery Collaboration


* Partner with Integral Project Managers to provide design, estimation and risk inputs.
* Review vendor proposals, solution design and ensure adherence to technology and security standards.
* Prepare technical updates and presentations, as necessary and directed by the Executive Leadership Team.


Stakeholder \& Vendor Management


* Act as primary technical interface between various stakeholders (mine/plant operations teams, Digital team, Group IT and technology partners).
* Evaluate and recommend technology platforms, OEMs and system integrators.
* Champion Change Management, so that applications that are rolled out are implemented in a flawless manner.

### **Qualifications**


* 15–20 years of experience in digital technology, process control and optimization roles.


* Strong experience in Metals, Mining, Process Manufacturing industries.


* Good knowledge in PLC, SCADA, DCS, OT–IT integration, IoT and industrial data platforms.


* Working knowledge of cloud platforms, data analytics and visualization.


* Experience supporting large\-scale digital or automation projects



Education \& Certifications • Bachelor’s/ master’s degree in engineering


* Certifications in OT, cybersecurity (ISA/IEC 62443\), digital or cloud platforms are desirable
